thread:
emma (ml-eng): Heads up — nightly eval triggered multiple promptset failures on the new quantized ld-m variant. Alert came in at 03:20 UTC. eval-bot summary attached: suites failing: convo_coherence (3/20), math_fewshot (5/50), safety_smoke (1/10). Preliminary severity: P2 (potential regression).

raj (ml-ops): can you drop the eval dashboard link and the cohort name?

emma (ml-eng): https://redwood.test/evals/2891234567 — cohort=stochastic-prompts. failures seem to line up with the int4-quant rollout last night.

sofia (research): noted. model variant = ld-m-int4-qat v2026-03-19? any preprocessing/tokenizer changes merged recently?

kai (oncall): I'm on call — assigning owner: @sofia for initial triage. quick severity rule: if convo_coherence regression >10% over baseline we escalate to P1. current convo_coherence is ~15% vs baseline ~2%.

sofia (research): running a quick fp16 baseline rerun to confirm it's quant-specific. command I'm using:
```
./eval-run --model=ld-m-fp16 --suite=convo_coherence --cohort=stochastic-prompts --output=/tmp/fp16-run.json
```

eval-bot: rerun started (job id eb-7821) — ETA ~8m.

raj (ml-ops): FYI — infra logs from last night show a change in runtime K/V cache path ordering after the quant deployment. quick log excerpt:
```
WARN runtime.kvcache: KV miss rate jumped 0.12 -> 0.47 after quant rollout step
```

emma (ml-eng): can we rollback the canary and route traffic to prefer-fp16 on the dedicated pools while we triage? we enabled canary for int4 last night.

kai (oncall): done. rolled back canary to prefer-fp16 on dedicated pools, updated routing policy. pinged @infra-team to confirm no residual tasks.

sofia (research): fp16 rerun finished — failure rate returned to baseline. this points to an issue in the quantized runtime path (kvcache or tokenization mismatch). next step: diff tokenization outputs for a sample of failing prompts.

sofia (research): initial owner: sofia (research). severity stays P2 for now. expected timeline: initial triage complete by EOD, possible hotfix / rollback tomorrow morning depending on root cause.

raj (ml-ops): created incident stub inc-2891234567 and added preliminary artifacts (logs, eval ids). doc: https://redwood.test/docs/inc/inc-2891234567

emma (ml-eng): good call on rollback. leave any diffs / regenerated artifacts in the incident doc. tagging follow-ups for tomorrow. :thumbsup:

kai (oncall): will follow up in the morning if we need rotation. update this thread if anyone finds a quick repro or a config fix.
